race.description: Become A Brc Member Mdn Hcp
race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade STEVIE'S SPIRIT (8) went down by a narrow margin at Ipswich on debut and will have taken a lot of benefit from that day at the races. Gets the services of Thompson in the saddle and should be able to sit up on speed from the low draw. Looks the one they all have to run down. GRAFFITUDE (6) was well in the betting on debut but just missed the frame on that occasion. Where there's smoke there's fire and watch for sharp improvement. TURBO COW (7) has shown plenty of ability at the trials and any market confidence must be noted. SUMMER SENSATION (13) has been thereabouts in all three runs this campaign and gets in light with the claim. In the mix.
